meta.stage: S2b (chrono_build_plan.md): actuator (V0 motor sign, V11, command ramp), crawler contact layout D (V0, settle, snapshots), R15 events
meta.model: outrigger_sim.chrono.model.L1Model(actuator=True), L1SpeedActuator (position motor + ChFunctionConst.SetConstant(s_ref), rate limit), crawler 24 spheres, ground bushing GroundBushingCoulomb (ball centre)

assumptions.ramp_source: user decision 2026-10-20 (CLAUDE.md), not in the YAML
assumptions.stroke_end: braking with the same acceleration limit (target speed <= sqrt(2 a d)); assumption of this implementation

meta.judgement: automatic pre-check; final physical judgement by dynamics-expert

reference.key_pose: reference.json / lift_V4_compliant_crawler / layouts / D rollers + gapped end shoes (YAML contact.crawler.sphere_layout) / settled_on_crawler (legs at 0) / q_about_origin (uz_mm, roll_deg, pitch_deg)
reference.key_modes: reference.json / lift_V4_compliant_crawler / crawler_on_floor_modes (layout D, legs at 0)
reference.note: reference = linear small-angle (no P-delta); the analytic start and Chrono use exact geometry (P-delta), so the pitch differs by the P-delta share

checks.item: motor +speed moves the pad down (sign of dz)
pad dz = -motor travel (link Z = body -z, R4)
motor reaction of a hanging rod = -m_rod g (+ pushes the pad down)
ramp0.1_dt1e-04: max |F_motor + m_rod g| (ramp 0.1 s, dt 0.0001 s)
ramp0.1_dt1e-05: max |F_motor + m_rod g| (ramp 0.1 s, dt 1e-05 s)
ramp0_dt1e-04: max |F_motor + m_rod g| (ramp 0.0 s, dt 0.0001 s)
ramp0_dt1e-05: max |F_motor + m_rod g| (ramp 0.0 s, dt 1e-05 s)
speed reaches v_max (ramp motion function, plan: ChFunctionConst)
full stroke time (rest to rest) = stroke / v_max + ramp
axial motor constraint |s_motor - acting target|, every step
no inertial spike: max |F_motor + m_rod g| <= m_rod a (1 %), whole V11 run
